owner.bio: I’m a Software Engineer passionate about building reliable, user-centered products from initial architecture to live production. Over the past year, I’ve delivered commercial web platforms and App Store mobile applications—including Observant Security and Tripod Hub—for UK clients, alongside building intelligent AI systems and cloud-backed architectures. Whether I’m shipping cross-platform apps, designing scalable APIs, or integrating LLMs, I focus on clean code, thoughtful design, and measurable real-world impact.
